title: ever NOIRE|Glitter V-Neck High Slit Sequin Shoulder Strap Wedding Guest Dress
descriptionHtml:
Make a dazzling entrance in this Glitter V-Neck High Slit Sequin Shoulder Strap Wedding Guest Dress. The shimmering sequins create a show-stopping look, while the v-neckline and high slit add a touch of sophistication. Whether you're attending a fancy cocktail party, a wedding reception, or a special celebration, this dress will make you the center of attention and leave a lasting impression.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Floor length.


Sleeve Style: Sleeveless.


Closure: It is concealed a zipper up the back.


Undergarments: It is not padded, no lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises sequin.


Stretch: Fabric is high stretch.

Occasion: Formal, Military Ball, Evening, Gala, Party, Wedding
